milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The target is the center of the birch fence enclosure at (6, 0, 8). The player must navigate within 16 blocks and face toward the fence structure (facing_tolerance=60°) to confirm they have visually identified it. This models 'player can see the birch fence' without requiring them to walk right up to it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The blue orchid is at (6, 0, 8) inside the fence enclosure. A tighter max_distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has actually approached the enclosure (entered or stood very close) to identify the small flower, rather than just seeing the fence from afar. facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking at the orchid's location.
